item.title: West Hill Lift gets £531,000 from National Lottery Heritage Fund
item.description: The National Lottery Heritage Fund has offered £531,000 in development funding to Hastings Borough Council to secure the long-term future of the West Hill Lift, the Grade II listed lift that runs up the cliff from George Street to Hastings Castle.
